about: License data that crate packages lack or misstate, read by scripts/release.py when it writes THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (D-122, docs/releases.md). Each entry holds for one crate version: when the graph moves the crate to another, check upstream again, refresh the files and update `version`. `texts` replaces the license texts the package lacks, `bundled` lists works the crate compiles in under another license than its own, and `fonts_reviewed` says why the package's font files never reach a binary. Files sit under licenses/, fetched upstream at the commit `source` names.
